Oversee statutory accounting, filing and governance requirements for the DACH legal entities, including Supervisory Board papers, in coordination with local directors, auditors, Tax, Legal, Treasury and Pension specialists - Oversee Treasury operations and local bank relations in line with the Global Treasury Standard, and implement required risk control and insurance standards - Act as a trusted adviser to DACH Finance and business leadership on accounting, reporting, risk and control matters, providing constructive challenge, translating complex topics into clear recommendations and holding senior stakeholders to account for timely resolution of risks - Lead, coach and develop the local Controlling team, setting clear priorities, accountabilities and performance expectations - Build capability in accounting, US GAAP, statutory reporting, SOX and risk management, and foster a culture of ownership, integrity and continuous improvement  REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS - 8+ years of Finance experience, including financial accounting, reporting and controls in an international organisation - Strong expertise in financial accounting, internal controls and risk management, including SOX or comparable control frameworks - US GAAP experience, or the ability to implement US GAAP requirements with specialist support - Strong knowledge of German statutory accounting and governance requirements, with a working understanding of tax matters - Good understanding of German pension accounting, reporting and governance requirements - Experience managing internal and external audits and driving remediation of findings - Proven people leadership, including delivering outcomes through cross-functional stakeholders - Strong judgement and clear communication, with the ability to explain complex financial matters to non-Finance audiences - Fluency in German and English  PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS - A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g. CA, CPA, ACCA or equivalent) - Experience across Germany, Switzerland and Austria - SAP S/4HANA experience WHAT WE OFFER YOU:- flexible hours and the option for remote work- 30 days of vacation plus December 24th and 31st off- Meal allowance: €65 per month- Access to Manager Check‑Ups – Optional executive‑level health screenings to support long‑term well‑being and performance- Company pension & shares- In-house café: snacks, lunch, and coffee specialties at discounted prices- ·Discounts via Corporate Benefits- Deutschland Ticket: €50 monthly subsidy or a discounted company bike- Free training opportunities and access to our own learning platform- E-GYM/Wellpass for €20 per month & free corporate health management & a 24/7 counseling service- And the best for last – unlimited ice cream!ARE YOU INTERESTED?Great!
